title: Underlying morphism lift
statement: Let X be Noetherian, J a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf, H, F, F′ coherent modules, and a:F→H, a′:F′→H morphisms whose kernels and cokernels are annihilated by positive powers of J. Given θ:completion(F)→completion(F′) with θ≫completion(a′)=completion(a), there exists g:F→F′ with g≫a′=a.

proof.text: On an affine open Spec A, identify coherent modules with finite A-modules M, M′, N and their formal completions with tensor products by the I-adic completion A-hat. Retain the map theta-hat induced by θ and the equation a′-hat theta-hat=a-hat from hθ.

Choose finite generators f_i of I. The torsion kernel/cokernel bounds make a and a′ isomorphisms after localization at every f_i. Set g_i=(a′_i)^(-1)a_i. These agree on overlaps, and hθ identifies their completed localizations with theta-hat by cancellation of a′_i.

For each x in M pair theta-hat(x) with g_i(x/1). Formal gluing exactness (Tag 05EK) for M′ produces a unique preimage g(x). Its injectivity proves linearity, and injectivity of the analogous map for N proves a′g=a. The completed component of this construction is theta-hat.

Transfer these module maps to coherent sheaf maps. On intersections refine by affine opens; the same completed component θ and localized comparisons, and injectivity of formal gluing, identify both restrictions. Glue the sheaf maps and check the equation on the affine cover. For I=0 completion is the constant system and θ itself is g; hθ is the required equation. For I=A use the inverse of a′; the empty scheme has unique morphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem torsionControlled_completion_hom_lift_raw
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (J : X.IdealSheafData)
    (H F F' : CoherentModules X) (a : F ⟶ H) (a' : F' ⟶ H)
    (ha : (∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι s).2
        (kernel a.hom)) ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι s).2
        (cokernel a.hom))))
    (ha' : (∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι s).2
        (kernel a'.hom)) ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι s).2
        (cokernel a'.hom))))
    (θ : (completion X J).obj F ⟶ (completion X J).obj F')
    (hθ : θ ≫ (completion X J).map a' = (completion X J).map a) :
    ∃ g : F ⟶ F', g ≫ a' = a

statement_change.what: The Lean signature omitted the completed comparison θ and compatibility hθ that the former prose intended. For J=0, F=F′=H=O_X on Spec(k), a=id and a′=0 satisfy both torsion bounds but admit no lift. Restore exactly θ and hθ as requested by reviewer X-a7def point 4.

old_proof.text: Construct localized comparison maps on an affine basis, descend them by exactness of the formal gluing complex, and glue the resulting coherent morphisms over X.

citers.note: Its hypotheses already include θ and hθ, so its stated use of raw existence still has the necessary premises. This does not validate the separate assertion that every raw lift has completion θ.
